why: Cycle 4 of the expression area (docs/v3/cycles/expression-4.md) ran on two referenced and four native cases, the referenced bank being empty after it: round-0 median 65, minimum 59, no case at 80, no P1 and 16 P2. 66 of 110 lost points were `skill`, 37 `primitive`, 4 `rubric` and 3 `planned`. Its fix rows (v3-expr-4-skill, v3-expr-4-kit-fixes, v3-expr-4-contract behind a Spec, v3-expr-4-rubric) change the skill, the kit, the contract and how two items are evidenced. change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n03, n07, n10, n14, n17 and n18 (all native; none has run). Every referenced case in the bank has run. Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `589cbb0` (2026-11-13; cycle 4 found none); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot, and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 4 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-4/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory; each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. Tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard frame and the pointer sweep of cycle 4's lead tool (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-4/lead-shots.ts`: announcement before and after each key, a gap frame with the dim state), and, if v3-expr-4-rubric landed, the keys the host's role takes and the list frame it names. (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Add two new cases to the bank from sources not used yet. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 4: (a) check before round 0 that v3-expr-4-kit-fixes (1) landed: probe a fill chart in a ChartCard at 390 and 1800 (cycle 4's `probe-fill.ts`): the svg must end inside the card box; if it did not land, say so in the cycle file and tell builders, so the box does not cost the same points twice; (b) check the linked-parts reference renders `focus.live` once (v3-expr-4-skill (1)); (c) run `make check-fast` before scoring round 0, and stop it by pid before builders start round 1 if it is still queued for a slot, since round 1 edits the tree; (d) builders of cycle 4 had no tool for the keyboard frame the skill asks for, and two wrote their own; say in the cycle file whether that is still true; (e) a page whose PageBar shows only a title keeps a 61 px band above its content (v3-dogfood-2-visual (2), noted from cycle 4): check whether that row landed before scoring, and tell reviewers if it did not; (f) report every score on all items and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone, as cycles 3 and 4 do.
